text: dsh-anthropic-image-clamp 是一个用于 DSH 的请求处理插件：它包装全局 fetch，只处理目标主机且路径包含 /v1/messages 的字符串请求体。插件会遍历 Anthropic Messages 请求中的内嵌 base64 图片，把长边超过配置上限的图片缩小，默认上限为 2000 像素；它还按图片内容摘要缓存结果，并在卸载时恢复原 fetch。适合在多图会话中避免超大图片继续导致请求尺寸错误。插件针对 api.anthropic.com 的请求工作，仍由原请求流程发送到该服务。

dsh-anthropic-image-clamp wraps global fetch for matching DSH /v1/messages requests. It downsizes inline base64 images longer than the configured limit, 2000 pixels by default, and caches results by content digest. Requests continue to api.anthropic.com.
Claude 多图会话总因图片尺寸超限失败，怎么让请求自动缩图？
让 DSH 发给 Anthropic 的超大内嵌图片先缩到指定边长。
Can DSH resize oversized inline images before sending Anthropic Messages requests?
dsh-anthropic-image-clamp 的功能「缩小请求图片」：自动检查匹配的 /v1/messages 请求，将长边超过 maxDimension 的内嵌图片缩小，默认上限为 2000 像素。
dsh-anthropic-image-clamp 的功能「缓存缩放结果」：按图片内容摘要缓存处理结果，后续请求可复用；缓存默认最多保留 256 项。

dsh-anthropic-image-clamp README · dsh-anthropic-image-clamp：Stops this Claude error in DeepSeek Harness:

```
messages.N.content.M.image.source.base64.data: At least one of the image
dimensions exceed max allowed size for many-image requests: 2000 pixels
```

dsh-anthropic-image-clamp README · dsh-anthropic-image-clamp：**Cause.** Anthropic allows up to 8000px per side, but a request carrying
more than 20 images is capped at 2000px per side. DSH normalizes attachments
to a 2048×2048 *pixel budget* (8192px long edge), so a phone screenshot such as
1080×2400 is stored as-is. Once a session's history holds more than 20 images,
every request fails.

dsh-anthropic-image-clamp README · dsh-anthropic-image-clamp：**Fix.** This host plugin wraps `fetch` for `api.anthropic.com/v1/messages`
requests and downscales any inline base64 image whose longer side exceeds
`maxDimension` (default 2000). The results are deterministic and cached by
content hash, so re-sent history stays byte-identical and the prompt cache
still hits.

Install, then restart DSH:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:noahchalifour/dsh-anthropic-image-clamp
```

Config override (profile `cordis.patch.yml`):

dsh-anthropic-image-clamp README · dsh-anthropic-image-clamp：```yaml
- id: anthropic-image-clamp
  config: { maxDimension: 1568, hosts: [api.anthropic.com] }
```

Limitation: requests routed through a subscriptions-plugin HTTP proxy use
undici's own fetch and bypass the wrapper. No proxy is configured on this
machine.
